sentences.en: A Bullying can take a variety of forms, from the verbal -being taunted or called hurtful namesto the physicalbeing kicked or shovedas well as indirect forms, such as being excluded from social groups.
sentences.zh: 欺凌者可以采取多种形式,从被嘲弄或称为伤害性的名字到被踢或鞭打的身体或被间接形式,如被排斥在社会群体之外。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: A survey I conducted with Irene Whitney found that in British primary schools up to a quarter of pupils reported experience of bullying, which in about one in ten cases was persistent.
sentences.zh: 我与艾琳·惠特尼进行的一项调查发现,在英国小学,多达四分之一的学生报告遭受欺凌,这在十分之一左右是持续发生的。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: There was less bullying in secondary schools, with about one in twenty-five suffering persistent bullying, but these cases may be particularly recalcitrant.
sentences.zh: 中学的欺凌现象较少,大约25人中有1人遭受持续的欺凌,但这些案件可能特别顽固。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: B Bullying is clearly unpleasant, and can make the child experiencing it feel unworthy and depressed.
sentences.zh: B欺凌显然令人不愉快,而且会使经历欺凌的儿童感到不值得,感到沮丧。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: In extreme cases it can even lead to suicide, though this is thankfully rare.
sentences.zh: 在极端情况下,这甚至可能导致自杀,尽管这很罕见。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Victimised pupils are more likely to experience difficulties with interpersonal relationships as adults, while children who persistently bully are more likely to grow up to be physically violent, and convicted of anti-social offences.
sentences.zh: 受害学生更有可能在成人人际关系方面遇到困难,而长期欺凌儿童则更有可能成长成身体暴力,并被判定犯有反社会罪。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: C Until recently, not much was known about the topic, and little help was available to teachers to deal with bullying.
sentences.zh: C直到最近,对这个专题了解不多,教师在处理欺凌问题方面几乎没有什么帮助。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Perhaps as a consequence, schools would often deny the problem.
sentences.zh: 也许因此,学校往往否认这个问题。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: ‘There is no bullying at this school’ has been a common refrain, almost certainty untrue.
sentences.zh: 校内没有欺凌行为, 常有的不作为,

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Fortunately more schools are now saying: There is not much bullying here, but when it occurs we have a clear policy for dealing with it. ’
sentences.zh: 幸运的是, 更多学校现在却说:这里的欺凌并不多,

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: D Three factors are involved in this change.
sentences.zh: D 这一变化涉及三个因素。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: First is an awareness of the severity of the problem.
sentences.zh: 首先,是认识到问题的严重性。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Second, a number of resources to help tackle bullying have become available in Britain.
sentences.zh: 第二,英国已经提供一些资源,帮助解决欺凌问题。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

words.def: 资源资源资源资源资源资源资源

sentences.en: For example, the Scottish Council for Research in Education produced a package of materials, Action Against Bullying, circulated to all schools in England and Wales as well as in Scotland in summer 1992, with a second pack, Supporting Schools Against Bullying, produced the following year.
sentences.zh: 例如,苏格兰教育研究理事会制作了一套材料,即《反对欺凌行动》,1992年夏季分发给英格兰和威尔士以及苏格兰的所有学校,第二套材料是《支持学校反对欺凌》,第二套材料是第二年制作的。

grammar.type: 分词结构 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: In Ireland, Guidelines on Countering Bullying Behaviour in Post-Primary Schools was published in 1993.
sentences.zh: 爱尔兰1993年出版了《关于打击小学后学校中欺凌行为的准则》。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Third, there is evidence that these materials work, and that schools can achieve something.
sentences.zh: 第三,有证据表明这些材料是有效的,学校能够取得一些成就。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: This comes from carefully conducted ‘before and after’ evaluations of interventions in schools, monitored by a research team.
sentences.zh: 这是由于在研究小组的监测下,对学校的干预工作进行了认真的 " 前后 " 评价。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: In Norway, after an intervention campaign was introduced nationally, an evaluation of forty-two schools suggested that, over a two-year period, bullying was halved.
sentences.zh: 在挪威,在全国开展了干预运动之后,对42所学校的评价表明,在两年期间,欺凌行为减少了一半。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 分词结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: The Sheffield investigation, which involved sixteen primary schools and seven secondary schools, found that most schools succeeded in reducing bullying.
sentences.zh: 涉及16所小学和7所中学的谢菲尔德调查发现,大多数学校成功地减少了欺凌行为。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: E Evidence suggests that a key step is to develop a policy on bullying, saying clearly what is meant by bullying, and giving explicit guidelines on what will be done if it occurs, what record will be kept, who will be informed, what sanctions will be employed.
sentences.zh: E 证据表明,关键步骤是制定一项关于欺凌的政策,明确说明欺凌的含义,并明确指导一旦发生欺凌将采取的行动,将保留哪些记录,谁将被告知将采用何种制裁。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: The policy should be developed through consultation, over a period of time-not just imposed from the head teacher’s office!
sentences.zh: 这项政策应该经过协商制定,时间不单是教师总长办公室强加的!

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Pupils, parents and staff should feel they have been involved in the policy, which needs to be disseminated and implemented effectively.
sentences.zh: 学生、家长和工作人员应当感到他们参与了这项政策,需要有效地传播和执行这项政策。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Other actions can be taken to back up the policy.
sentences.zh: 还可以采取其他行动支持这项政策。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: There are ways of dealing with the topic through the curriculum, using video, drama and literature.
sentences.zh: 课程中也有一些方法,通过视频、戏剧和文学来处理这个问题。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: These are useful for raising awareness, and can best be tied in to early phases of development while the school is starting to discuss the issue of bullying.
sentences.zh: 这些课程对提高认识很有用,最好与早期发展阶段挂钩,而学校则开始讨论欺凌问题。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: They are also useful in renewing the policy for new pupils, or revising it in the tight of experience.
sentences.zh: 它们在更新新学生政策或根据经验紧张的情况修订政策方面,也是有益的。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: But curriculum work alone may only have short-term effects; it should be an addition to policy work, not a substitute.
sentences.zh: 但是,单靠课程工作可能只产生短期效果;它应当是政策工作的补充,而不是替代。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: There are also ways of working with individual pupils, or in small groups.
sentences.zh: 也有与个别学生或小群体合作的方式。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Assertiveness training for pupils who are liable to be victims is worthwhile, and certain approaches to group bullying such as ‘no blame’, can be useful in changing the behaviour of bullying pupils without confronting them directly, although other sanctions may be needed for those who continue with persistent bullying.
sentences.zh: 值得为可能成为受害者的学生提供补偿培训,某些对付集体欺凌的办法,如 " 无责怪 ",可以有助于改变欺凌学生的行为,而不必直接面对他们,尽管对那些继续不断欺凌的学生可能需要其他制裁。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Work in the playground is important, too.
sentences.zh: 在操场工作也很重要

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: One helpful step is to train lunchtime supervisors to distinguish bullying from playful fighting, and help them break up conflicts.
sentences.zh: 一个有益的步骤是培训午餐时间主管,以区分欺凌和玩弄游戏,帮助他们打破冲突。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Another possibility is to improve the playground environment, so that pupils are less likely to be led into bullying from boredom or frustration.
sentences.zh: 另一种可能性是改善操场环境,这样学生就不太可能因为无聊或沮丧而受欺凌。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: F With these developments, schools can expect that at least the most serious kinds of bullying can largely be prevented.
sentences.zh: F 随着这些事态发展,学校可以预期,至少可以在很大程度上防止最严重的欺凌行为。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: The more effort put in and the wider the whole school involvement, the more substantial the results are likely to be.
sentences.zh: 学校投入的努力越多,学校参与的广度越大,结果可能就越大。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The reduction in bullying – and the consequent improvement in pupil happinessis surely a worthwhile objective.
sentences.zh: 减少欺凌现象 — — 以及由此改善学生幸福肯定值得追求。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。
